subject: Request: Pilot extension & one-off credits for ACME Health
messages:
From: Alex Simmons <alex.simmons@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Pilot extension & one-off credits for ACME Health

Hi Vivek,

Quick ask — our pilot is going well but we hit token limits during this week’s integration tests. Can Redwood issue a one-off credit or promo code so we can extend the pilot through the end of November? If possible we’d like 5k–10k tokens to run an extra set of performance tests and a short user study.

Appreciate a quick yes/no — we’re trying to keep the momentum with the product team.

Thanks,
Alex Simmons
Senior PM, ACME Health
alex.simmons@acmehealth.com

--
Attachments:
- sample_test_logs.txt (referenced, not attached in thread)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Simmons <alex.simmons@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot extension & one-off credits for ACME Health

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and congrats on the progress. I can usually arrange a one-off credit for pilots like this. Couple quick Qs so I can process internally:

- Expected token usage range (rough number is fine)
- Is this tied to the current HubSpot deal (RDW-DEAL-01927)?
- Any procurement constraints or PO needed to accept the credit?

Looping in Monica (CS) and Lauren (sales ops) to validate impact. I’ll request a manual promo code from RevOps once we have those details.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension & one-off credits for ACME Health — request for manual promo code

Folks — forwarding the ACME request. They’re asking for a one-off credit (~5k tokens preferred, 10k as an upper bound) to keep the pilot going through 11/30. Deal is RDW-DEAL-01927; HubSpot link below.

Attached: pilot_metrics_snapshot.csv (quick usage numbers they sent).

Business justification: high-touch healthcare prospect, strategic potential in patient triage workflows. We want to avoid throttling and keep a few feature experiments running.

Ask: Can RevOps generate a manual promo code and confirm any limits (per-account, single-use, expiry)? If approved I’ll send to the customer and confirm redemption details.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/1927

— Vivek

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension & one-off credits for ACME Health — request for manual promo code

Vivek / Lauren — approved for a one-off promo under our discretionary trial program. Conditions:

- Issued amount: 5,000 free tokens (we can increase to 10k after post-issue review)
- Promo code: ACME-ONEOFF-1126
- Expiry: 30 days from issuance (2026-12-05)
- Scope: single HubSpot account / single customer org; non-transferable; cannot be combined with other promos
- Limitations: applies only to text generation endpoints (not embeddings)

I attached the promo_request_form.pdf for audit. I’ve provisioned the code in the promo console and set the redemption to single-use and tied to account domain acmehealth.com. Please confirm if you want me to redeem it on their behalf or have them redeem.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- promo_request_form.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 12:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Promo code ACME-ONEOFF-1126 — confirm limits

Thanks Marcus — quick clarification:

- Can the promo be applied across multiple API keys that the customer uses (they have a staging and prod key)?
- Will finance need a chargeback or memo for accounting?

If it’s tied to the domain and single-redeem, it should be fine for the pilot. If you can set it to allow redemption by multiple keys for the same org, that avoids us doing a manual redemption.

— Lauren

Good news: we’ve approved a one-off credit for ACME Health. Details below — we’ve provisioned the promo in the console; you can redeem or we can apply it for you.

- Promo code: ACME-ONEOFF-1126
- Amount: 5,000 free tokens
- Valid for: text generation endpoints only
- Expiry: 2026-12-05 (30 days)

Redeem here: https://console.redwood.ai/promo/redeem/ACME-ONEOFF-1126

If you’d like us to apply the credit directly to your account, reply with the account ID or the HubSpot deal number and we’ll perform the redemption.

Best,
